policy.course_bearing: Do not infer a bearing from an un-georeferenced spectator map.
policy.wind: A race needs timestamped wind plus a surveyed sectional bearing before a headwind/crosswind component is calculated.
policy.lane: Do not infer a lane bias from winners. Use an official lane/path feed or leave it missing.
policy.path: Official steward incidents are admissible runner path evidence, but are separate from a continuous lane measurement.

sources.finding: ATC publishes live racecourse wind direction and speed, but no public historical race-by-race archive was established.
Official course geometry and start maps are available, but the diagrams do not establish surveyed sectional bearings.
VRC describes five live track wind points and minute logging; the public page does not expose the required historical archive.
The official map anchors the site to named boundary streets, but is not a surveyed sectional-bearing dataset.
